text_block_list.text:
We're at a festival close to summer
camp. Even
here, Т.М. Опера О is in top
form.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Behold that vendor over yonder!
Thrusting out in
a fine display are none
other than legendary
chocolate banana
swords!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We must draw them at once and free the
goldfish
from their watery dungeon! Let
us fry noodles and
octopi while we're at
it!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Mommy, Mommy! Look at her! Isn't she
funny?
text_block_list.name: Girl

text_block_list.text: Shh! It's rude to stare.
text_block_list.name: Mother

text_block_list.text:
Just as Opera O stokes her enthusiasm
for the
festival...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Um... Hello there!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This festival is all well and good, but I
was
wondering if you would like to join
the greatest
summer festival.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The greatest, you say? And what makes
it so,
Grass? Fireworks, perhaps?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: No, something even more impressive.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You know my classmate, El Condor
Pasa? Her
race overseas will be
broadcast there, live.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Since it's happening during camp, I've
been
asking everyone to watch it with
me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
El's race! But of course, I would heartily
join in!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So, the older generation is already
making
headway abroad... I must
observe it for myself!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The big race viewing party is today, and
everyone
is beaming with excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Go for it! El, El—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: YAAAAAY!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The winner is Эль Кондор Паса! El Condor
Pasa
takes first!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Her splendid win proves that even in
Europe,
Japanese Umamusume are a real
force to be
reckoned with! The gates to
a new age are open!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Magnificent... Just... Aaahh, what
splendor!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For a Japanese Umamusume to shine so
brightly
in France, one of the great
nations of opera!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You were rooting for El, weren't you,
Opera O?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Rooting? Hardly! I am the one who soon
will
outpace and conquer the previous
generation.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I am merely happy to see those who
thrived last
year continue to grow
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The stronger my adversary, the more
valuable
their defeat! The stories of their
downfall shall set
passions ablaze!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
After all, the star that is I shines most
brilliantly
when opposed by a
consummate foe.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ambitious, aren't you? El and I won't
lose, just so
you know.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Me neither! El beat me in last year's
Japan Cup,
but things will be different
this time!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Just what I wished to hear! However,
you'd best
steel thyselves first for the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Consider it my first official clash against
the two
of you, if you so desire!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I'd love to!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And so, they promise to face each other
at the
end of the year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing as how we are already here and
together,
and I can hardly wait for the
main act...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Why not have a showdown, as a
rehearsal of
sorts, during our summer
camp excursion?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That sounds like a fine idea to me. It will
be a nice
change from our usual training.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I hope your trainer has no objections.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Of course not. Don't hold back.

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О is skilled enough to
handle
anything that comes up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of special training it
is, I
want her to go all out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, Opera O. Who would you like
to
challenge?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! We're both pretty tough! Who
will it be?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I shall defer judgment to the one
whom I
trust more than any other.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, who do you think would provide
the
better challenge?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик is known for her speed
and power.
She can overtake anyone in a
quick burst.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As for Грасс Вандер, I've heard she has
the heart
of a fighter and thrives on
competition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The best one for Т.М. Опера О to
compete
against is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You picked me!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
All right! We'll face off tomorrow instead
of our
normal training!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hope you're ready to work at the beach
house
together, Opera O.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Putting up beach umbrellas, carrying
boats...
Whoever makes more people
smile wins!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! You can carry those hulking
boats
with your bare hands?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You'd never make it in Hokkaido if you
couldn't
lift a tractor out of a ditch!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Good luck trying to beat us if you can't
even lift a
little boat!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You have left me in awe of Hokkaido. It
is truly
the kingdom of bogs and hearty
root vegetables!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Very well! I accept this travail you've
proposed,
and I shall emerge victorious!
Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O works up a sweat, refusing to
lose to
Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You chose me, and I accept. ♪ But just
the two of
us running kind of lacks
performative flair...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
How about we do something to go hand
in hand
with summer camp? For
instance...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The warm breeze carries the sound of
cicadas
buzzing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I challenge you to write haiku poetry
under the
hot, summer sun. Can you
compose a poem while
enduring the
intense heat?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Composing verse in this wretched
heat?
How barbaric this open-air stage
is...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
An opera of torture! Is this the power of
my
predecessors?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I'll go first.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
By summer winds swept Till risen to
nirvana My
mind will soon be
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Now, your turn.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Ngh... too hot... to think...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
However, this sweltering oblivion is
becoming a
fresh source of inspiration!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hark, you Overlord Endure you must,
Overlord
You are beautiful
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: No seasonal words, huh?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Summer, Overlord ...Will make you
sweat,
Overlord You are beautiful
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She manages to learn a bit about work
and social
responsibility while also
building up her strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While Opera O's take on haiku is
certainly
unique, it seems Grass
Wonder's challenge has
given her a
boost in guts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
